title: Grain load intake
prompt: Hand-written fixture: a load intake flow — intake form, contract match, settlement summary.

directions.title: Form-first intake
directions.note: Single direction exercising form controls, a table, StatusBadge, and edges between all three screens.

screens.title: New load intake
screens.description: Scale ticket entry: ticket number, farm, commodity, gross bushels, moisture.

screens.title: Contract match
screens.description: Open contracts table; apply the load to a contract.

screens.title: Settlement summary
screens.description: Shrink, net bushels, and settlement value.
